title: Years between Great Barrier Reef mass bleaching events

source.name: Aerial surveys of coral bleaching on the Great Barrier Reef

notes: The gap from the 1998 to the 2002 event was 4 years; from 2002 to 2016 was 14 years, the longest gap on record. Since 2020, mass bleaching events (2020, 2022, 2024) have averaged about 2 years apart.
